_meta.rule_under_test: Section escalation isolation — escalation in one section must NOT affect findings in other sections
_meta.direction: MIXED — section 3.2.S.3 escalates; sections 3.2.S.1 and 3.2.S.5 stay clean
_meta.description: Five findings across three CTD sections. In 3.2.S.3, two findings both FLAG (R1 and R2 respectively), triggering the section escalation rule — both promoted to ESCALATE. In 3.2.S.1 one finding PASSes cleanly. In 3.2.S.5 one finding PASSes cleanly with all IPRP keywords present. This confirms that the section flag counter is per-section: the 3.2.S.3 escalation must NOT bleed into 3.2.S.1 or 3.2.S.5. A fifth finding in 3.2.S.1 also PASSes, confirming two PASSes in a section do not interact with two FLAGs in a different section.
